summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the Socratic EdTech and Adaptive Exam Preparation Platform (SocratesAI / HocThongMinh), detailing the Socratic Tutor with line-by-line follow-up dialogue, content-to-study materials transformer (flashcards, quizzes, smart summaries), dynamic adaptive exam planner with auto-rescheduling, and personal knowledge radar analytics with parent/mentor oversight view.
